name: Neem salad
summary: Gỏi sầu đâu is the salad VnExpress gives to Châu Đốc and to An Giang: shoots and leaves of the wild sầu đâu tree, bitter, then sweet, and cool, with dried cá sặc, dried cá lóc, or meat and shrimp. The dressing is mắm me with sugar, garlic, and chili. Some people blanch the leaves first.
origin: Châu Đốc and An Giang, on VnExpress, 26 Apr 2024. The photograph credit on that article is An Giang Online.
taste: VnExpress says the plate holds bitter, sour, salty, and sweet: tamarind, the bitter-then-sweet leaf, and chili.
howToEat: The leaves are mixed with dried cá sặc, dried cá lóc, or meat and shrimp. Blanch them first if you want less bitterness, which VnExpress says many people do.
The dressing is mắm me, sugar, garlic, and minced chili. A price was not printed. Check on arrival.
where: Châu Đốc. A street was not printed. Check on arrival.
